summary: Matador Resources filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to its secured revolving credit facility, reaffirming the $3.25B borrowing base and increasing committed borrowings to $2.75B. The filing also discloses results of the annual shareholders meeting (June 11, 2026) with standard director and auditor ratification votes. No special situation such as an M&A transaction, activist campaign, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The credit amendment is an ordinary course financing arrangement.
